description.message: TonTuyau's browser extension: sends your YouTube cookie to your TonTuyau, and adds "Add to TonTuyau" buttons to YouTube.

sendHint.message: Only the youtube.com cookies are sent. TonTuyau checks them at once by reading your Liked videos.

notSetUp.message: Not set up yet: give it a TonTuyau's address and a browser-extension API key.

failureNoCookie.message: No YouTube cookie in this browser: sign in on youtube.com first, then send it again.

failureKeyRefused.message: TonTuyau refused the API key (unknown or disabled): check it in the settings.

failureKeyNotAllowed.message: This API key isn't a browser-extension key: make one of that kind in TonTuyau.

cookieRefusedHint.message: YouTube refused it: you're signed out of YouTube in this browser, or your session expired. Sign in on youtube.com, then send it again.

cookieUncheckedHint.message: YouTube couldn't tell (a bot check, the network): TonTuyau checks it again later.

urlHint.message: The address you open TonTuyau at. The browser asks once to let LaPompe reach it.

keyHint.message: Made in that TonTuyau: Admin → API keys → New key, kind "Browser extension". Shown once there: paste it here.

everyHint.message: $1 or more, to each TonTuyau above, on one alarm. YouTube renews its cookies while you browse: a short interval keeps TonTuyau's copy working.

permissionRefused.message: Without your leave, LaPompe can't reach $1.

keyNotAKey.message: A TonTuyau API key starts with tt_.

optionsNote.message: Saving asks the browser for leave to reach those addresses only (no other site), and youtube.com for its cookie; a TonTuyau removed gives its leave back. The keys stay in the browser's extension storage, never in a web page.

addNeedsAdding.message: Needs a TonTuyau that downloads videos (2.0 or later; yours has $1).

waitingHint.message: In TonTuyau's queue: it's downloaded when its turn comes.

addNotSetUp.message: Set LaPompe up first: its settings, from its toolbar button.

addVersionUnknown.message: LaPompe doesn't know yet whether your TonTuyau can add: test the connection in its settings.

channelIdUnknown.message: YouTube's page didn't say which channel this is.

cookieToEvery.message: Your YouTube cookie goes to every TonTuyau listed here.

cookieToEveryHint.message: It's your signed-in YouTube session: add only TonTuyau whose owner you'd trust with it.

urlTwice.message: This TonTuyau is already in the list.

permissionRefusedAll.message: Without your leave, LaPompe can't reach these addresses: nothing was saved.

sendNowAll.message: Send the cookie now, to all

addNoneCan.message: None of your TonTuyau can add yet: test their connection in LaPompe's settings (2.0 or later can).

addGone.message: This TonTuyau is no longer in LaPompe's settings.
